phase_prompt.label: Default
phase_prompt.summary: The sky as a vast, photorealistic expanse with ancient-tech motifs and advanced crystalline structures.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, ancient-tech sky blending Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs with advanced, incomprehensible technology: layered azure to indigo expanse, crystalline cloud formations refracting light into prism patterns, luminous glyphs etched across the horizon, a central crystalline sun emitting bioluminescent rays, faint metallic filaments resembling ancient armor, subtle dust motes illuminated by unseen engines, and a faint lattice of solar conduits visible in the twilight, all rendered with tactile realism and grounded industrial mysticism.
